problem: Prove that BeBee can add a fourth authored woodland region with Rose/Bluebell identity while reusing movement-through pollination, Honey, Flight/Buzz 3, restoration, save v4 and region analytics, without adding a new verb, currency, mandatory spend, lethal hazard or per-region lifecycle.

decision.rationale: The exact-head deterministic and Chromium journey validates Rosewood as region_04 in the same continuous authored world. Four new Meadows complete through the existing movement-through pollination verb, reuse Honey and Buzz 3, reload through save v4, and retain the six-slot nearby-patch pool. Rose Glade, Bluebell Hollow, Cedar Turn and Woodland Crown provide authored woodland identity through palette, landmarks and route language without a new hazard or management layer. The independent evaluation accepts the slice with the explicit geometric-art deviation carried forward to P8.

governance.trust_boundary_change: No governance-critical file, workflow, validator, ruleset, permission or trust-boundary behavior is changed by this player-facing slice. The manifest is ordinary same-PR feature evidence.
governance.bypass_analysis: No governance bypass is introduced or used. Exact-head CI, trusted evidence policy, diff classification, deterministic tests and retained artifacts remain the authority for this PR.
governance.rollback: Revert this feature PR to remove the Rosewood content and bounds changes; save v4 and the existing adapters remain authoritative.
